annotations.title: Calculate aspect ratio and crop/pad plan

description: Reduce any pixel size to its simplest aspect ratio (1920x1080 is 16:9) and the nearest even size an H.264 encoder accepts, and, given a target ratio, solve the missing width or height and return the centre-crop and letterbox/pillarbox plans with the px trimmed or added per edge. Use this for arbitrary sizes and ratios (cinema 2.39:1, a client's 4:5); when the target is a named platform placement, use get_social_media_placement with sourceWidth/sourceHeight instead, which picks the right ratio for you. Errors on a non-integer or out-of-range size, or on only one of targetRatioW/targetRatioH.

targetRatioH.description: Height term of the target ratio, e.g. 16 for 9:16. Requires targetRatioW.

targetRatioW.description: Width term of the ratio to crop or pad to, e.g. 9 for 9:16 or 2.39 for 2.39:1. Requires targetRatioH.
